status: post hoc exploratory numerical and permutation sensitivity
depth_policy: Nearest normalized residual depth: embedding=0; block i=(i+1)/L; ties choose shallower. Final normalized output excluded. Depth is not functional homology.

multiple_comparisons.family: 2 numerical policies x 2 permutation schemes x 3 model pairs x 2 poolings x 5 depths
multiple_comparisons.earlier_adjustments: Within-condition30 and within-numerical-policy60 values retained as provenance; they are not this family's final correction

original.scope: all selected model cosine RDMs and all conventional baseline cosine RDMs; integer length controls unchanged
original.interpretation: Numerical sensitivity resolution, not a proof of exact mathematical ties or literary validity

rounded12.operation: numpy.round applied uniformly before ranking or downstream distance summaries
rounded12.scope: all selected model cosine RDMs and all conventional baseline cosine RDMs; integer length controls unchanged
rounded12.interpretation: Numerical sensitivity resolution, not a proof of exact mathematical ties or literary validity

original_policy_provenance: Missing metadata in legacy original reports is interpreted as their documented unrounded default
